generations.zh: 当前代：218B 总参 / 25B 激活 MoE（128 专家激活 8 + 1 共享），128K 输入 / 64K 输出上下文，支持视觉输入；Apache-2.0。
generations.en: Current generation: a 218B-total / 25B-active MoE (8 of 128 experts plus one shared), 128K input / 64K output context, vision inputs supported; Apache-2.0.

generations.zh: 上一代：command-a-07-2025（HF 门控，本站 2026-10-20 直抓返回 401 需登录）与 vision / reasoning / translate 变体在册。
generations.en: Previous step: command-a-07-2025 (gated on HF — our 2026-10-20 fetch returned 401 without login) plus vision / reasoning / translate variants listed.

generations.zh: 更早一代（command-r / r-plus / r7b 系列在册，CC 系非 OSI 许可）。
generations.en: The earlier line (command-r / r-plus / r7b listed, CC-family non-OSI licences).

sizeTiers.zh: 旗舰 218B MoE（25B 激活，多卡/大显存）
sizeTiers.en: Flagship 218B MoE (25B active; multi-GPU / large VRAM)

sizeTiers.zh: 上一代 r7b（7B 级，单卡）

licenses.zh: Apache-2.0（Command A+ README：「License: Apache 2.0」；上一代 command-a-07-2025 为门控发布）
licenses.en: Apache-2.0 (Command A+ README: "License: Apache 2.0"; the previous command-a-07-2025 was gated)

claims.zh: 官方 README：「25 billion active parameters and 218B total parameters … optimized for agentic, multilingual, and reasoning-heavy tasks」「Context length: 128K input」（企业向定位与基准数字为厂商口径）。
claims.en: Official README: "25 billion active parameters and 218B total parameters … optimized for agentic, multilingual, and reasoning-heavy tasks"; "Context length: 128K input" (the enterprise pitch and benchmark numbers are vendor framing).

positioning.zh: Cohere 的企业向 agentic 家族：A+ 放开了 Apache-2.0（上一代还是门控），主打企业场景与多语言。尺寸在 218B 级，本地部署门槛高。本站未收其量化对比（GGUF 生态太薄，见下）。
positioning.en: Cohere's enterprise agentic line: A+ opened up under Apache-2.0 (the previous generation was gated), pitched at enterprise and multilingual work. At 218B scale the local-deployment bar is high. This site carries no quantisation comparison (GGUF ecosystem too thin — see below).

onSite.zh: 本站未收 Command 的量化对比：command-a 系 GGUF 生态实测约 31k 下载（2026-10-20 HF 检索），远低于本站 ~30 万门槛——与 A6.5 盘点「主流不等于有量化版可用」同一现象。
onSite.en: No quantisation comparison on this site: the command-a GGUF ecosystem measured ~31k downloads (HF search 2026-10-20), far below the ~300k threshold — the same A6.5 finding that "mainstream does not mean quantisations people actually use".
